sloka: दूषणम् च खरम् चैव हतम् त्रिशिरसम् रणे ।दृष्ट्वा पुनर् महानादम् ननाद जलद उपमा ॥३-३२-२॥
transliteration: dūṣaṇam ca kharam caiva hatam triśirasam raṇe ।dṛṣṭvā punar mahānādam nanāda jalada upamā ॥3-32-2॥

translations.english: Seeing Dusana, Khara and also Trisira along with the fourteen thousand demon warriors of terrific performance killed by Rama, singlehanded, Surpanakha roared like a cloud.
